# Atelier Click FX · 工坊星涟
English | 简体中文
A small, independent visual plugin for **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI and Desktop**. Mouse clicks random
ly alternate between **five distinct animations**: star ripples, lace blossoms, comet showers, orbit
ing stars and fluttering butterflies. Each uses the current theme’s soft gold, porcelain white and p
eriwinkle blue, then fades in **0.72–0.9 seconds**.
Designed to complement the navy, gold and lace of **Maid Atelier / 深海女仆工坊**. It reads the active ski
n's colors and ships no third-party skin artwork. It uses the same native DSH package, profile-patch
and browser-module conventions as the dsh-web-all family, but is an independent plugin and is not b
undled with that project.
## Install
Requires DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 or newer** with its `dsh` command available on PATH. Desktop users can reg
ister the command through the app's command-management menu. No separate model, API key, native buil
d tools or plugin dependencies are needed.
**Desktop:** fully quit the application, then run the following in Terminal, PowerShell or your Linu

The repository contains ready-to-load JavaScript; installing it does not run a build script. Release
s include a `SHA256SUMS.txt` for the packaged artifact. This release is distributed through GitHub,
not the npm registry.
## Behavior

- A short primary mouse or pen click creates one approximately 110 CSS-pixel effect.
- A shuffled ba
g plays all five effects once in each group of five accepted clicks; adjacent groups never repeat th

e same effect at their boundary. Dragged, long or rate-limited clicks do not consume a choice.
- The
effects differ in shape and motion, not just color. Their palette is sampled from the active skin o

n every click.
- Drags, long presses, secondary buttons and touchscreen scrolling do not trigger it.

- The overlay never intercepts input or takes focus. No sound, cursor trail or idle animation.
- At
most eight effects coexist; rapid clicks are rate-limited. The canvas backing buffer is capped at a

pproximately eight million pixels.
- Effects clear when the app loses focus, becomes hidden or resiz

es.
- **Reduce Motion** is respected immediately: no effects play while that preference is enabled.

- Disabling the plugin disposes its canvas, event listeners and animation frame.
- No network calls,
telemetry, model usage, storage access or persistent click history.

## Languages
The DSH plugin list title and description, plus the standalone preview, support **English, Simplifie
d Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Russian**. DSH metadata lives in `locale/*.json`, inclu
ding `zh` and `zh-CN` aliases. The animation contains no text and works with any UI language.
The production plugin follows the host's locale resolution; the preview has its own language selecto
r and browser-language default. English is the metadata fallback. Do not change the package ID or mo
dule registration ID when translating display text.
## Platforms and verification
| Platform | Runtime design | Validation |
| macOS | DSH Desktop or Web GUI | Actual Desktop click rendering, input focus and navigation verifi

ed |
| Windows | DSH Desktop where available, or Web GUI | Node 22/24 automated CI; native UI not ma

nually tested |
| Linux | DSH Desktop where available, or Web GUI | Node 22/24 automated CI; native
UI not manually tested |
The plugin uses browser Canvas and Pointer Events and contains no OS-specific commands, filesystem p
aths or native modules. The CI matrix checks JavaScript syntax, package/locale integrity, host loadi
ng and lifecycle behavior on all three operating systems. These checks use a simulated DOM/Canvas; t
hey are not a substitute for native UI testing.
## Theme integration
Colors are sampled on each click, so a skin change does not require restarting the effect:
| Role | Preferred token | Fallback |

| Warm outlines and stars | `--maid-gold-soft`, then `--maid-gold` | `#e2cfaa` |
| Blue accents and

particles | `--maid-periwinkle`, then `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` | `#8ea5da` |
| Porcelain highligh
ts | `--maid-porcelain`, then `--dsw-alias-label-primary` | `#f8f6f0` |
The plugin remains usable without Maid Atelier or dsh-web-all. It does not edit either package, add
settings panels or change the selected skin. It decorates the renderer's content area, not the opera
ting system's title bar, menus or dialogs.
## Develop and preview
[代码示例省略，未执行]
No dependency installation is required. Open `preview.html` in a modern browser for an interactive d
emo using the **same `client.js`** as DSH. The preview’s demo button plays five randomly selected cl
icks using the same shuffled sequence; it also respects Reduce Motion.
`index.js` is the deliberately empty host entry; `client.js` registers a lazy browser module with DS
H and owns all effects through `ctx.effect`. `cordis.patch.yml` adds one independently toggleable ro
w. Public package metadata is exported through `package.json` and `locale/*`.
